Spatial domains with BANKSY

runBanksy.Rd

Runs BANKSY (Singhal et al. 2024) through the Bioconductor package Banksy (see banksyParam()), stores its PCs as a dimension reduction (method "banksy") and clusters them into domains (cell metadata name): by default with Giotto's sNN network and Leiden, as Giotto::findSpatialDomains(method = "neighborhood") does with the native embedding, so the two can be compared directly.

The input is expression by default, which is what Banksy is designed for. With input = "dim_reduction" (e.g. PCs) Banksy discards the sign of the neighbour means (see banksyParam()) and a warning is given; Giotto::runNeighborhoodPCA() keeps it.

If you use it, please cite the original paper (see References).

Usage

runBanksy(
  gobject,
  spat_unit = NULL,
  feat_type = NULL,
  input = c("expression", "dim_reduction"),
  expression_values = "normalized",
  feats_to_use = "hvf",
  dim_reduction_to_use = "pca",
  dim_reduction_name = NULL,
  dimensions_to_use = NULL,
  spat_loc_name = "raw",
  lambda = 0.8,
  k_geom = 15L,
  npcs = 20L,
  compute_agf = FALSE,
  seed = 1234L,
  cluster_method = c("giotto", "banksy", "none"),
  k_neighbors = 30L,
  resolution = 0.8,
  name = "banksy",
  verbose = NULL
)

Arguments

gobject

giotto object

spat_unit, feat_type

spatial unit and feature type

input

"expression" (default) or "dim_reduction"

expression_values

expression values with input = "expression"

feats_to_use

features with input = "expression": a character vector or the name of a logical feature metadata column (default "hvf"); NULL uses all

dim_reduction_to_use, dim_reduction_name, dimensions_to_use

the embedding with input = "dim_reduction"

spat_loc_name

name of the spatial locations

lambda, k_geom, npcs, compute_agf, seed

see banksyParam()

cluster_method

"giotto" (sNN network + Leiden), "banksy" (Banksy::clusterBanksy()) or "none"

k_neighbors

neighbours of the sNN network

resolution

Leiden resolution

name

name of the PCs, the network and the domain column

verbose

be verbose

Value

The giotto object with the BANKSY PCs and the domains.

References

Singhal V, Chou N, Lee J, et al. BANKSY unifies cell typing and tissue domain segmentation for scalable spatial omics data analysis. Nature Genetics 56, 431–441 (2024). doi:10.1038/s41588-024-01664-3

See also

banksyParam(), Giotto::runNeighborhoodPCA(), Giotto::findSpatialDomains()

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
g <- GiottoData::loadGiottoMini("visium")
g <- runBanksy(g, lambda = 0.8)
} # }
